page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core. It includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.sn2.xlarge exhibits weak to average performance across various workloads. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng, falls into the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, memory bandwidth read operations are relatively weak, though large block write operations achieve average performance at 33.29 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates average capabilities in Passmark CPU scores and extended instruction tests, but performs poorly in single-threaded compression and decompression tasks. Small-model LLM inference tasks achieve average speeds, whereas medium-model text generation is poor.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance offers a stable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. However, the lack of local storage and the modest benchmark results suggest it is best suited for workloads that do not require high-performance computing or high-speed local disk I/O. Appropriate applications include moderate web serving, basic database operations, light background processing, and small-scale language model inference where high throughput is not critical.
